test_title: PYST 202: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 26th Nov, 2021 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are numbered from 1 to 6. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the face showing '2'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/946a5f598042aae8c9a37ad7d2ba965c7d1cf3c76d05b9f106c2b43f639bd639.png]
solution:
In first and second dice 4, 6 are common in both dice.

First dice is rotated anti-clockwise in horizontal direction the other adjacent side of 4, 6 is '2'.

As from above dices the opposite side of 5 is '2'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a303ac7c98bc2a1f8fa209cc668b5fbe5a53dee415e14cb0a66fc053ab5ff605.png] 

Logic : If two dice have the same two face value in the given image then the third number is opposite to each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bb76c9f9b197b1273cca7776d671a370006917912f3f6ad58b0d72a793ad0038.png] 

In first dice and second dice.

Numbers 4, 6 are common.

∴ Here, '5' is opposite face showing face '2'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"5".**
